# ChatGPT Custom Instructions Generator

> Free browser tool that builds paste-ready ChatGPT custom instructions and Claude project instructions. No signup; nothing leaves your browser.

- Primary use: generate a system / custom-instructions block from role, audience, tone, rules, and output format
- Platforms: ChatGPT Custom Instructions, Custom GPT instructions, Claude Projects, Gemini system instructions
- Soft product (optional): https://v8gt0i-12.myshopify.com/products/ai-bot-workflow-template-pack

## Key facts

- Free, no account, no API call
- All formatting runs client-side in the browser
- Live URL: https://system-prompt-builder.vercel.app/
